mapper.insert: INSERT INTO country_info ( country_id, country_code, country_name, country_name_cn, continent, continent_cn, longitude, latitude, note ) VALUES ( #{countryId}, #{countryCode}, #{countryName}, #{countryNameCn}, #{continent}, #{continentCn}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{note} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE country_code = VALUES(country_code), country_name = VALUES(country_name), country_name_cn = VALUES(country_name_cn), continent = VALUES(continent), continent_cn = VALUES(continent_cn), longitude = VALUES(longitude), latitude = VALUES(latitude), note = VALUES(note)

INSERT INTO city_info ( city_id, city_name, city_name_cn, state_id, state_name, state_name_cn, country_id, longitude, latitude, note ) VALUES ( #{cityId}, #{cityName}, #{cityNameCn}, #{stateId}, #{stateName}, #{stateNameCn}, #{countryId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{note} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE city_name = VALUES(city_name), city_name_cn = VALUES(city_name_cn), state_id = VALUES(state_id), state_name = VALUES(state_name), state_name_cn = VALUES(state_name_cn), country_id = VALUES(country_id), longitude = VALUES(longitude), latitude = VALUES(latitude), note = VALUES(note)
